release_decision.release_scope: experimental LoRA adapter plus exact base revision; full merged model only after a separate verified export, never label adapter as complete 27B weights

limitations: Constructed repository defects, not historical issue benchmark results.
One training seed, 24 fresh tasks clustered in four repositories.
Python/JavaScript scope; no advanced multilingual or long-context certification.
Small supervised pilot; quality improvement is a measured outcome, not promised.
Training failure controls are deliberately constructed from training snapshots, not sampled model mistakes or distilled hidden reasoning.
